messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: platform-service v2.14.3 -> prod. Feature flag ff/compaction-low-latency will be toggled according to rollout plan: 0% -> 1% at +10m -> 5% at +30m -> 25% at +60m -> 100% at +3h. Canary region: prod-eu-west. Change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 5m, 95p latency +20% vs baseline, error-rate on /v1/generate >0.3%, or any SLO alerts firing. If rollback needed, pin routing to v2.14.2 and disable the flag immediately. Release notes: https://redwood/release/2.14.3. @alicia @mike @sre-oncall please eyeballs.
alicia: LGTM, oncall here and watching the dashboards.
mike: Quick Q — does this flag touch the embedding pipeline? If compaction interferes with KV writes we should keep embeddings pinned to m1 for safety.
rav: It touches the KV cache write path (small compaction job). I'll enable extra traces and watch the write latency spans.
sasha: I'll create a short dashboard tile for compaction_errors and compaction_write_latency.
deploy-bot: Canary: ff/compaction-low-latency -> 1% in prod-eu-west now.
alicia: seeing a small blip: error-rate +0.08% not sustained yet.
mike: agreed on rollback criteria. If /v1/generate error-rate crosses 0.3% for 5m, rollback immediately and pin.
rav: prepping rollback snippet:
```
# rollback playbook (snippet)
- set routing tag platform-service:v2.14.2
- disable flag ff/compaction-low-latency
- drain canary hosts: /drain --service platform-service --region eu-west
- notify #incidents and product
```
rav: Filing ticket RWD-5421 to capture KV write traces and compaction commit logs.
oncall-bot: Alert: compaction-worker CPU >90% (eu-west) — surgeguard evoked.
alicia: scaling compaction-worker pool +2 nodes, taking nodes from spare pool.
mike: Is that enough to prevent tail latency? If not we should rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at +35m: routing pinned to v2.14.2 and ff/compaction-low-latency set to 0%. Canary hosts drained. Notifying release owners.
mike: Thanks — reopening the cut for investigation. Please attach any related logs to RWD-5421.
sasha: Posting a short note with dashboards and screenshots to the ticket.
alicia: Good catch everyone. Blocking redeploy until fix merges and we validate in staging.
rav: I'll run targeted unit/regression tests for KV write flush and compaction race conditions.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: rollback succeeded, prod routing stable on v2.14.2. Follow-up postmortem to be scheduled in #postmortems.
